name: czrecoil_frame_update_joystick_cmd_ui
description: CZRecoilFrame::OnUpdateJoystickCmdUI enables and checks the joystick command UI from the zInp option.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x431970 yet; the handler currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x431970 validates Enable(TRUE), GetJoystickOption, and SetCheck(option != 0).
The native menu-toggle smoke enables joystick through the toggle handler, then verifies OnUpdateJoystickCmdUI enables and checks the command UI.
